name: Foxtail Millet Khichdi
category: Healthy Rice, Millet and Grain Dishes
ingredients: ¼ cup split yellow moong dal, rinsed
1 extra cup non-starchy vegetables (spinach, cabbage or green beans), chopped
steps: Heat the oil, crackle the cumin and add the ginger.
Add the extra chopped vegetables together with the other vegetables.
Add the millet, dal, vegetables, turmeric and salt and stir for 1 minute.
Add the water and pressure-cook for 3 whistles, or simmer covered for 25 minutes.
Rest for 5 minutes, then mash lightly to a soft consistency.
note: Foxtail millet is rich in fibre and has a lower glycaemic response than polished rice.
